newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread up as Goldman repeats "outperform".
newsitem.headline: Whitbread up as Goldman repeats "outperform".

text.p: Shares in Whitbread Plc rose on Monday as analysts at Goldman Sachs repeated an "outperform" rating on the stock following an upbeat meeting with executives from the company on Friday, market sources said.
The stock was up 5p at 787-1/2 by 1238 GMT in modest volume of just over half a million shares. Goldman analysts were not immediately available for comment.
Whitbread chief executive Peter Jarvis told Reuters on Friday that the company had turned in a "sound" performamnce in the last three months of the year ended February 28.

He said the company had plans to open another 200 outlets in its restaurant, pub and coffee shop chains through the next year -- which he said was the strongest pipeline of new openings it had ever had.
Whitbread said today it planned to open 35 new Costa Coffee shops in Britain by early 1998.
